payout_quote: For every dollar you deposit to the TNStars account by June 30 of the qualifying period, the State will match it with $4 - up to $500 per child, per year, with a lifetime maximum match of $1,500.
steps: Check eligibility at Treasury.TN.gov/TIPS (Tennessee resident, child 14 or younger, household income limits).
Complete the TIPS Program Application during the qualifying period (applications accepted through June 30, 2026).
Once approved, open a TNStars account for each child (as little as $25 to start).
Deposit to the TNStars account by June 30 of the qualifying period; the state matches $4 for every $1 deposited.
catches: Tennessee residents only; the child must be 14 or younger; household income limits apply (reference-guide example: a family of 4 earning under $80,375 can qualify).
4-to-1 on YOUR deposits: deposit $25, get $100; deposit $125, get the $500 yearly max; deposit $0, get $0.
Applications and qualifying deposits for the current period close June 30, 2026.
$500 per child per year and a $1,500 lifetime maximum match per child.
Standard 529 risk: non-qualified withdrawals face federal income tax on earnings plus a 10% federal penalty - consult a tax advisor.
biggest_catch: Income-capped and age-capped (child 14 or younger): the 4-to-1 match applies only to your own deposits - up to $125 per child per year for the $500 match - with a $1,500 lifetime cap per child.
eligibility: Tennessee resident applicant with a child age 14 or younger meeting TIPS household income requirements.
timing: Current qualifying period: applications and qualifying deposits through June 30, 2026; match on deposits made August 1-June 30 of the qualifying period.
payout_value_note: 4-to-1 on own deposits; $25 min deposit earns $100; $500/yr and $1,500 lifetime max per child.
numeric_basis: payout from official TN Treasury terms (4-to-1, up to $500/yr); time: eligibility check + TIPS application + TNStars account opening, est. 20-30 min active.
